sources.entry: Postal - Complete and fully featured mail server for use by websites & web servers. (Source Code) MIT Docker/Ruby

summary.one_liner: Postal is an open-source, self-hosted mail server for websites and web servers, positioned as an alternative to hosted transactional email services such as Sendgrid, Mailgun, or Postmark.
summary.what_it_does: Postal is described in its README as a complete and fully featured mail server intended for use by websites and web servers. The README frames it as a self-hostable version of hosted email-delivery services like Sendgrid, Mailgun, or Postmark. The README itself is brief and only links to external documentation, installation instructions, FAQs and features, discussions, and a Discord server, so specific capabilities are not detailed in the README text provided. Listings in the source lists tag it as Docker and Ruby based.
use_cases: send email from a web application
run your own mail server for websites
how_to_run: See the installation instructions linked from the README (external documentation; commands not included in the README text provided)
notable: Self-hosted alternative to Sendgrid, Mailgun, and Postmark
Described as a complete, fully featured mail server
Documentation, FAQs, and Discord hosted externally
caveats: README is brief and defers setup and feature details to external documentation
Running a mail server requires self-managed infrastructure and deliverability setup
